structured_output.notes: The Hindu, New Indian Express, ET and Moneycontrol were blocked, so I could not read the original articles for these leads. They are unverified: the GBA Bannerghatta Road junction DPR (13–14 Oct), the Finance Department concerns on the Hebbal tunnel, Tejasvi Surya's 'unscientific' remark, the Jalahalli Cross underpass, the Mysuru Road bridge and the Swan Realty Bodhi launch in Jayanagar. Jayanagar is outside this task's focus. The Surya remark appears to be a recurring criticism: search results show 2025 and June 2026 versions. Search snippets say the cabinet approved Rs 2,215 crore for the Hebbal tunnel and the Mehkri Circle elevated corridor, and that the tunnel contract (about Rs 1,140 crore) was awarded in June to Rithwik Projects and AMRIL. These came from Deccan Herald via search only, so I did not claim them. The Devanahalli fatal accident (BJP worker, 14 Oct) is not real-estate relevant. No Electronic City, Hosur Road, Kanakapura Road, Kengeri or Tumkur Road items were found inside the window. Prestige Springwood (Devanahalli) was reported by blogs as an October 2026 launch, with RERA not filed as of June; this is unverified.
